elements.label: Figure 7.7
elements.title: Schematic diagram illustrating the function F as a composite process
elements.details: The diagram shows the function F as a composite process involving weights W and biases B applied to input x, producing output ŷ, which is compared to true output y via a loss function C. The process involves a forward pass through the neural network, application of activation function (sigmoid), and calculation of loss (MSE). The diagram likely includes nodes representing input x, weights W, biases B, activation function σ, output ŷ, true output y, and loss function C, connected in sequence to illustrate the composite function F(w,b).
elements.summary: This diagram visually explains how the neural network function F combines weights, biases, input, activation function, and loss calculation into a composite process used for training.
